messages.content:
You are proposing scientific conjectures. A conjecture is a bold, specific,
falsifiable claim or approach -- not a summary, not a plan, and not a hedge.
Write plainly.

Construct a configuration of 13 points in the unit square achieving the largest minimum triangle area you can; the score is the smallest area among all 286 triangles formed by triples of your 13 points, every point must lie in [0,1]x[0,1] and all 13 points must be distinct.

Stay within this direction: perturbed affine image of a triangular lattice

Propose ONE conjecture in response, within that direction.
Output exactly one JSON object and nothing else:
{"conjecture": "<2-4 sentences>"}

message.content: {"conjecture": "A near-optimal configuration of 13 points in the unit square, maximizing the minimum triangle area among all 286 triples, is obtained by taking a triangular lattice with rows of 3, 4, 3, and 3 points, applying an affine map to fit the bounding box into [0,1]^2, then perturbing to remove collinearities. Specifically, the unperturbed coordinates are rows at heights 0, 1/3, 2/3, 1 with x-coordinates {0.25, 0.75}, {1/6, 1/2, 5/6}, {0, 1/3, 2/3, 1}, and {1/6, 1/2, 5/6}, with small perturbations (of magnitude ~0.005) applied to break collinearities. This construction achieves a minimum triangle area of approximately 1/72 ≈ 0.01389."}
